info.title: Campus Mate — Proposed ASP.NET API
info.description: Frontend contract for a future backend. No ASP.NET backend is included. JSON uses camelCase keys; property ids are integers, other ids are strings. Bootstrap is role-scoped, never returns passwords, and supports an anonymous guest response.

userId.description: Real tenant account linked to this roommate profile; required server-side to deliver meeting invitations.

roommateId.description: Required when roommate is true; null when renting alone. The tenant chooses the roommate profile.
Required when roommate is true; null when renting alone. The tenant chooses the roommate profile.

roommateName.description: Name snapshot resolved by the server from roommateId.

payments.description: Always empty: rent and deposits are handled directly by the parties.

checkoutUrl.description: HTTPS provider URL for the landlord listing fee only. The server charges JD 20 and publishes only after verified payment and moderation. Never used for tenant rent or deposits.

source.description: prepared-example identifies a saved presentation fixture, not a live AI result.
